data.one_liner: Flutter library for showing animated toast notifications with templates.
data.what_it_does: Provides a service to display customizable animated toast notifications such as message, widget, success, warning, and error toasts.
use_when: You need to display quick feedback messages or alerts in your Flutter app.
You want built-in animated toast variants like success, warning, and error messages.
avoid_when: You need complex local or push notification management systems.
strengths: Comes with multiple pre-styled toast templates (success, warning, error, message, widget).
Supports custom animations, curves, and styling options.
weaknesses: No advanced scheduling or persistent notification support.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight native-feeling toast library across platforms.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: For modern customizable toast notifications with rich UI styling.

alternatives.name: bot_toast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a highly flexible toast and notification system that can overlay anything.
